Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Description:
Find the plugin you want without hunting through repository lists. Omega brings official and community Dalamud plugins into one searchable storefront with Spotlight, screenshots, tags, compatibility, source choice, and security insights.

Open Omega with /omega or /omg. Discover plugins, compare repositories, inspect what a plugin can access, install through Dalamud, and keep your Library and Updates together.
Changelog: Security Evidence v2 is now the production scanner state with fail-closed staged publication, resolved NuGet recovery from packaged .deps.json, OSV/IPC/dependency indexes, and marketplace projection from validated v2 evidence.
